name: Ishinagare Souseki / Stone River
original_name: 石流 漱石 / ストーンリバー
source:
A member of "Thieves' Empire".
A stern man who battles with a katana. His Toys allow him to immobilize an opponent. Undercover as a school janitor, and sometimes as a chef.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tantei_Opera_Milky_Holmes#Thieves.27_Empire]Wikipedia[/url].]
